title: Jack Howard's influence on her left hand
summary: Jack Howard taught her to play the left hand louder than the right and many professional things; he followed her mother's circle from Atlanta to Pittsburgh.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Jack Howard was an influence as far as giving me strength on the piano. He told me always to play the left hand louder than the right because that's where the beat and the feeling was. It's just like a drum keeping a steady beat. He taught me a lot of professional things it would have taken me years and years to learn.
You first met him in Atlanta?
Yes. The first date that I began to play my mother got him to come in...
And then he was in Pittsburgh later?
